About Me

Making India's streets safer for everyone who walks, drives and rides.

I'm a Transportation Engineering M.Tech student at IIT Roorkee. I'm fascinated by how people read the road and decide at a crossing, and I love turning those insights into practical, people-first safety improvements.

Pedestrian SafetyMixed Traffic Smart CrosswalksRoad-User Behavior Intelligent Transportation Systems

What I work on

Safer streets start with how people see them

Crossing safety depends on how pedestrians and drivers read the road, trust the information they get, and decide whether to cross or yield. My research studies exactly that.
